title: Wisdom, a Hidden Treasure
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who goes looking — and tonight Solomon tells a child that the best thing there is has been hidden on purpose, for someone willing to search.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to search out good and wonderful things. In Scout’s world today: Scout wanted to build the tallest sandcastle but didn’t know how. Instead of giving up, Scout asked Grandpa, who knew a clever trick — wet sand sticks better! Scout listened, tried it, and built a mighty castle. Just like Solomon said to hunt for wisdom like treasure, Scout discovered that listening to wise helpers is like finding gold.
